rationale: B has a clearer compiled-operation design, factors binary stack handling into an atomic pop2 helper, and supports definitions spanning lines or appearing alongside other input. Its definition-time resolution consistently preserves Forth redefinition semantics and rejects undefined words immediately. A is more repetitive, partially mutates the stack on binary-operation underflow, restricts definitions to lines beginning with ':', and inconsistently resolves known words eagerly but unknown words lazily, allowing surprising forward-reference behavior.
